# BillShock

> Deterministic, zero-dependency Agent Skill, CLI & GitHub Action (`BILL001`–`BILL016`) exposing runaway loops, uncapped AI token bombs, N+1 DB egress, hung retries, connection-pool leaks, aggressive crons, and PR guardrail regressions before deploy.
